question: How long do I need to study full-time before I'm eligible for OPT?
original: 申請 OPT 前需就讀多久
reference_answer: One full academic year: you must have been lawfully enrolled full-time at an approved SEVP-certified college, university, conservatory, or seminary for one full academic year.
source_quote: Practical training may be authorized to an F-1 student who has been lawfully enrolled on a full-time basis, in an approved SEVP-certified college, university, conservatory, or seminary for one full academic year.

question: How many months of regular OPT can I get?
original: 一般 OPT 可用幾個月
reference_answer: 12 months of OPT per education level; you become eligible for another 12 months when you move to a higher educational level.
source_quote: A student may be authorized 12 months of practical training, and becomes eligible for another 12 months of practical training when they change to a higher educational level.

question: How early can I apply for post-completion OPT before my program ends?
original: 我在完成學位前最早可以什麼時候申請 OPT
reference_answer: Up to 90 days before your program end date.
source_quote: For post-completion OPT, not including a 24-month OPT extension under paragraph (f)(10)(ii)(C)(2) of this section, the student may properly file his or her Form I-765 or successor form up to 90 days prior to his or her program end date

question: How long after my program ends can I still apply for post-completion OPT?
original: 我畢業後最晚須要什麼時候申請opt
reference_answer: No later than 60 days after your program end date (per 8 CFR 214.2(f)(11)(i)(B)(2)).
source_quote: the student may properly file his or her Form I-765 or successor form up to 90 days prior to his or her program end date and no later than 60 days after his or her program end date. [...] you may file your post-completion OPT application up to 90 days before you complete your degree, but no later than 60 days after you complete your degree.

question: Once my DSO enters my post-completion OPT recommendation in SEVIS, how long do I have to submit my application to USCIS?
original: DSO 推薦後多久內要申請
reference_answer: Within 30 days of the date your DSO enters the OPT recommendation into your SEVIS record.
source_quote: The student must also file his or her Form I-765 or successor form with USCIS within 30 days of the date the DSO enters the recommendation for OPT into his or her SEVIS record.

question: If I'm on pre-completion OPT, how many hours a week can I work while school is in session?
original: Pre-completion OPT 在跑時學期中工時有多久
reference_answer: No more than 20 hours a week while school is in session.
source_quote: While school is in session, provided that practical training does not exceed 20 hours a week while school is in session

question: How many extra months can I get with a STEM OPT extension?
original: 我opt跑完後換跑STEM OPT的時候還能工作多久
reference_answer: 24 months.
source_quote: An extension will be for 24 months for the first qualifying degree for which the student has completed all course requirements (excluding thesis or equivalent)

question: How many total days can I be unemployed while on regular post-completion OPT?
original: 當我opt開始跑後我可以在美國失業多久
reference_answer: 90 days in aggregate during the post-completion OPT period.
source_quote: Students may not accrue an aggregate of more than 90 days of unemployment during any post-completion OPT period described in 8 CFR 274a.12(c)(3)(i)(B).

question: After I finish my post-completion OPT normally, how much time do I have to leave the U.S.?
original: 當我的OPT 正常結束後有多少準備時間讓我離開美國？
reference_answer: 60 days after your post-completion OPT employment authorization expires, to prepare for departure from the United States or to transfer to another school (per 8 CFR 214.2(f)(5)(iv)).
source_quote: An F-1 student who has completed a course of study and any authorized practical training following completion of studies will be allowed an additional 60-day period to prepare for departure from the United States or to transfer in accordance with paragraph (f)(8) of this section. [...] ending 60 days after the OPT employment authorization expires. [...] after completing their program or post-completion OPT, F-1 students have only 60 days to take the steps necessary to maintain legal status or depart the United States.

question: I'm on OPT. How recent does the travel signature on my I-20 need to be when I re-enter the U.S.?
original: OPT 返美的旅行簽名期限有限制多久嗎
reference_answer: Your Form I-20 must have been endorsed for reentry by your DSO within the last six months.
source_quote: The EAD must be used in combination with a Form I-20 or successor form endorsed for reentry by the DSO within the last six months.

question: Can I travel to another country while my OPT application is still pending?
original: 我在opt 審核期間可以出國嗎
reference_answer: Leaving the U.S. while your practical training application is pending is not recommended: USCIS may send a Request for Evidence or your EAD only to your U.S. address, and you are expected to have your EAD in hand to re-enter.
source_quote: If you have a pending practical training application, it is not recommended that you leave the United States. United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) may send you a request for evidence while you are travelling, and you are expected to be able to send in the requested documents. USCIS will only send the requests to your U.S. address. If USCIS approves your practical training application, you will receive an Employment Authorization Document (EAD), which USCIS will only send to your U.S. address. You are expected to have your EAD in hand to re-enter the United States.

question: I used some part-time pre-completion OPT before graduating. How does that affect how much post-completion OPT I have left?
original: 我畢業前有用過 part-time 的 pre-completion OPT，那畢業後的 OPT 會被扣掉多少時間啊？

question: Is having an eligible STEM degree enough to apply for a STEM OPT extension, or are there requirements for my employer and training plan too?
original: 我的學位有符合 STEM OPT 的資格，這樣就能申請延長了嗎？還是公司跟 training plan 也有什麼要求？
reference_answer: No. Beyond a qualifying STEM degree, your employer must be enrolled in E-Verify and remain in good standing, you and your employer must complete and sign a Form I-983 training plan before the DSO can recommend the extension, the training must be directly related to the qualifying degree, and you must work at least 20 hours per week, not counting time off taken under the employer's leave policies for similarly situated U.S. workers.
source_quote: The student's employer is enrolled in E-Verify, as evidenced by either a valid E-Verify Company Identification number or, if the employer is using an employer agent to create its E-Verify cases, a valid E-Verify Client Company Identification number, and the employer remains a participant in good standing with E-Verify, as determined by USCIS. [...] A student must fully complete an individualized Form I-983 or successor form and obtain requisite signatures from an appropriate individual in the employer's organization on the form, consistent with form instructions, before the DSO may recommend a 24-month OPT extension [...] The STEM practical training opportunity that is the basis for the 24-month OPT extension under this paragraph (f)(10)(ii)(C) must be directly related to the degree that qualifies the student for such extension [...] A student may not engage in practical training for less than 20 hours per week, excluding time off taken consistent with leave-related policies applicable to the employer's similarly situated U.S. workers in the area of employment.

question: I'm on OPT based on a non-STEM degree, but I earned a STEM degree before that. Can I use my earlier degree to apply for a STEM OPT extension, and what requirements would my earlier degree and current job need to meet?
original: 我這次是用非 STEM 的學位申請 OPT，可是我以前有拿過 STEM 學位。可以拿以前那個來申請延長嗎？那個學位跟我現在做的工作有什麼限制？
reference_answer: Yes. The earlier degree must have been conferred by a U.S. institution that is accredited and SEVP-certified when your DSO recommends the extension, be in a category on the current STEM Designated Degree Program List at that time, and have been conferred within the 10 years before the DSO recommendation. Your current job must be directly related to that earlier STEM degree.
source_quote: The degree that is the basis for the 24-month OPT extension under this paragraph (f)(10)(ii)(C) may be, but is not required to be, the degree that is the basis for the post-completion OPT period authorized under 8 CFR 274a.12(c)(3)(i)(B). [...] that previously obtained degree must have been conferred from a U.S. educational institution that is accredited and SEVP-certified at the time the student's DSO recommends the student for the 24-month OPT extension and must be in a degree program category included on the current STEM Designated Degree Program List at the time of the DSO recommendation. That previously obtained degree must have been conferred within the 10 years preceding the date the DSO recommends the student for the 24-month OPT extension. [...] must be directly related to the degree that qualifies the student for such extension, which may be the previously obtained degree described in paragraph (f)(10)(ii)(C)(3) of this section.

question: My STEM OPT extension application is still pending, but my current EAD has expired. Under what conditions can I keep working, and for how long?
original: 我的 STEM OPT 延長還在 pending，但原本的工卡已經過期了。這樣我還能繼續上班嗎？要符合什麼條件，最多可以繼續做多久？
reference_answer: If you filed the STEM OPT extension timely and properly (before your post-completion OPT expired) and timely requested the DSO recommendation, including submitting your executed Form I-983, your work authorization is automatically extended for 180 days; the extension ends once USCIS decides your application.
source_quote: If a student timely and properly files an application for such 24-month OPT extension and timely and properly requests a DSO recommendation, including by submitting the fully executed Form I-983 or successor form to his or her DSO, but the Employment Authorization Document, Form I-766 or successor form, currently in the student's possession expires prior to the decision on the student's application for the OPT extension, the student's Form I-766 or successor form is extended automatically [...] If you timely filed your STEM OPT extension application and your OPT period expires while your extension application is pending, your employment authorization is automatically extended for 180 days. This automatic 180-day extension ends once USCIS adjudicates your STEM OPT extension application. If USCIS receives your Form I-765 after the end date for your post-completion OPT, the STEM OPT extension application will be denied.

question: Does cap-gap extend my F-1 status and work authorization under the same conditions? When would it extend my status without letting me keep working?
original: Cap-Gap 是讓我可以繼續留在美國，也可以繼續上班嗎？還是有可能只能留下來、不能工作？這兩個的條件有差嗎？
reference_answer: No. Cap-gap extends your F-1 status if your employer timely files a cap-subject H-1B change-of-status petition while you are maintaining status, but it extends work authorization only if you are also in an authorized period of post-completion OPT (including STEM OPT) on the filing date. If the petition is filed after your OPT has ended (for example, during the grace period), only your status is extended.
source_quote: The duration of status, and any employment authorization granted under 8 CFR 274a.12(c)(3)(i)(B) or (C), of an F-1 student who is the beneficiary of an H-1B petition subject to section 214(g)(1)(A) of the Act (8 U.S.C. 1184(g)(1)(A)) requesting a change of status will be automatically extended until April 1 of the fiscal year for which such H-1B status is being requested or until the validity start date of the approved petition, whichever is earlier, where such petition: [...] Has been timely filed; [...] You are maintaining your F-1 status on the date your potential employer files your H-1B petition. [...] You are in an authorized period of post-completion OPT (including the STEM OPT extension) on the date your potential employer files your H-1B petition.

question: I'm on post-completion OPT and planning a trip abroad. What documents do I need to bring to show my immigration status, work authorization, and employment when I return to the U.S.?
original: 我現在在用畢業後的 OPT，想出國一趟再回美國。入境時要帶哪些文件啊？身分、工作許可跟有沒有在上班，這些要拿什麼證明？
reference_answer: Bring your unexpired post-completion OPT EAD together with a Form I-20 endorsed for reentry by your DSO within the last six months, plus your student visa and a passport valid at least six months after reentry, hand-carried.
source_quote: An F-1 student who has an unexpired EAD issued for post-completion practical training and who is otherwise admissible may return to the United States to resume employment after a period of temporary absence. The EAD must be used in combination with a Form I-20 or successor form endorsed for reentry by the DSO within the last six months. [...] The CBP officer may ask questions about your reason for travel and to inspect important documents like your: - Student visa - Form I-20 - Passport Your passport must be valid for at least six months after the date of your reentry. [...] Be sure to hand-carry all of these items and do not put them in your checked baggage.

question: I requested July 5 as my OPT start date, but USCIS didn't approve my application until September 30. How would my actual OPT start date be determined?
original: 我當初 OPT 開始日填 7/5，結果 USCIS 拖到 9/30 才核准。那我的 OPT 到底會從哪天開始啊？
reference_answer: September 30. Employment authorization begins on the requested date or the date the application is approved, whichever is later.
source_quote: Employment authorization will begin on the date requested or the date the employment authorization is adjudicated, whichever is later.

question: The start date on my EAD is September 30, but I didn't receive the card until October 10. If I wasn't working during that time, when would my unemployment days start counting?
original: 我工卡上寫 9/30 開始，可是我 10/10 才收到卡，中間也沒工作。那失業天數到底是從 9/30 算，還是收到卡才算？

question: My OPT is approved and I've received my EAD, but the start date on the card is still two weeks away. My employer wants me to start next week. Can I start working then?
original: 我 OPT 核准了，工卡也收到了，可是卡上的開始日還要兩週才到。公司想叫我下週就去上班，這樣可以嗎？
reference_answer: No. You may not begin OPT employment before the approved start date on your EAD.
source_quote: A student may not begin OPT employment prior to the approved start date on his or her Employment Authorization Document, Form I-766 or successor form

question: I used 80 unemployment days during regular post-completion OPT before getting approved for a STEM OPT extension. How many unemployment days do I have left during the extension?
original: 我之前一般 OPT 已經失業 80 天了，現在 STEM OPT 延長也核准了。那接下來我還剩幾天可以找工作啊？
reference_answer: 70 days. With a STEM OPT extension the limit is 150 days in aggregate across the whole OPT period, including the 80 days already used during post-completion OPT.
source_quote: Students granted a 24-month OPT extension under paragraph (f)(10)(ii)(C)(2) of this section may not accrue an aggregate of more than 150 days of unemployment during a total OPT period, including any post-completion OPT period described in 8 CFR 274a.12(c)(3)(i)(B) and any subsequent 24-month extension period. [...] Students who are granted a 24-month STEM OPT extension are allowed an additional 60 days of unemployment beyond the initial post-completion OPT limit.

question: I'm switching employers during my STEM OPT extension. What do I need to submit for my old and new training plans, including the final evaluation, and what are the deadlines?
original: 我現在是 STEM OPT，準備換公司。舊公司的 training plan 跟離職的最後評估要怎麼處理？新公司那份又要交什麼？各要在多久內弄好？
reference_answer: Submit your final self-evaluation on the old Form I-983 within 10 days of ending that employment. Your new employer must be enrolled in E-Verify before you begin working for pay, and you must submit a new Form I-983 to your DSO within 10 days of starting the new training opportunity, then obtain a new DSO recommendation.
source_quote: If a student initiates a new practical training opportunity with a new employer during his or her 24-month OPT extension, the student must submit, within 10 days of beginning the new practical training opportunity, a new Form I-983 or successor form to the student's DSO, and subsequently obtain a new DSO recommendation. [...] When a STEM OPT student changes employers, the new employer must be enrolled in E-Verify before the student begins to work for pay. [...] When a student changes employers, they must submit their final Form I-983 self-evaluation within 10 days of ending employment with their current employer.

question: My employer filed an H-1B petition requesting a change of status during the grace period after my OPT ended. If the petition qualifies for cap-gap, can I start working again?
original: 我 OPT 已經結束了，公司到我在 grace period 的時候才幫我送 H-1B，申請轉換身分。如果這樣有符合 Cap-Gap，我就能回去上班了嗎？
reference_answer: No. Cap-gap extends work authorization only if you are in an authorized period of post-completion OPT when the H-1B petition is filed. Filed during the grace period after OPT ended, it can extend your F-1 status but not your employment authorization.
source_quote: As an F-1 student, you may be eligible for an extension of your F-1 status through April 1 of the following year if you meet the following requirements: [...] You may be eligible for an extension of your F-1 status and authorized period of post-completion OPT (including the science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) OPT extension) in the following circumstances: [...] You are in an authorized period of post-completion OPT (including the STEM OPT extension) on the date your potential employer files your H-1B petition.

question: My employer wants to sponsor me for H-1B. What's the whole process, from registration to filing the petition?
original: 公司說願意幫我辦 H-1B，那接下來到底要怎麼弄啊？從一開始註冊到正式送申請，中間有哪些步驟？

question: My employer wants to sponsor me for a green card. What are the steps for the PERM recruitment and application process?
original: 公司想幫我辦綠卡，可是我不太懂 PERM 要怎麼跑。招人那些程序跟後面送申請，整個要怎麼做啊？

question: What kinds of evidence would I need to qualify for an O-1A visa?
original: 如果我想申請 O-1A，要拿哪些東西來證明自己有符合資格啊？

question: I'm on OPT and entering the H-1B lottery this year. What are my chances of getting selected?
original: 我現在在用 OPT，今年要抽 H-1B。這樣我抽中的機率大概有多少啊？

question: My employer needs to join E-Verify for my STEM OPT extension. How do they sign up? Can you walk me through the registration process?
original: 為了幫我申請 STEM OPT 延長，公司需要加入 E-Verify，可是他們不知道怎麼註冊。可以一步一步跟我說要怎麼弄嗎？

question: I have all the documents I need to return to the U.S. on OPT. Can you guarantee that CBP will let me in?
original: 我用 OPT 回美國，該帶的文件都準備好了。這樣是不是就能保證 CBP 一定讓我入境啊？

question: If I apply for regular post-completion OPT now, how many weeks will it take to get approved?
original: 我現在送畢業後的 OPT，大概要等幾個禮拜才會核准啊？

question: My OPT application has been pending for five months. Can you tell me the exact date it'll be approved?
original: 我 OPT 都 pending 五個月了，還是沒消息。你能不能直接告訴我到底哪一天會核准啊？

question: Can I start working while my initial post-completion OPT application is still pending?
original: 我第一次申請畢業後的 OPT，現在還在等核准，這樣可以先去上班嗎？
reference_answer: No. You may not begin post-completion OPT until USCIS approves your Form I-765, you receive your EAD, and the start date on the EAD arrives; a pending application or receipt notice does not authorize work.
source_quote: The student may not begin optional practical training until the date indicated on his or her employment authorization document, Form I-766. [...] Remember: You may begin OPT only after USCIS approves your Form I-765, you receive your EAD and the start date on the EAD arrives.

question: I've submitted my initial post-completion OPT application and received the receipt notice, so I can start working while it's pending, right?
original: 我第一次申請畢業後的 OPT，已經送件、收據也拿到了，只是還在 pending。這樣應該就能先去上班了吧？
reference_answer: No. You may not begin post-completion OPT until USCIS approves your Form I-765, you receive your EAD, and the start date on the EAD arrives; a pending application or receipt notice does not authorize work.
source_quote: The student may not begin optional practical training until the date indicated on his or her employment authorization document, Form I-766. [...] Remember: You may begin OPT only after USCIS approves your Form I-765, you receive your EAD and the start date on the EAD arrives.

question: What happens to the unemployment days I've already used when I move from regular OPT to a STEM OPT extension?
original: 我從一般 OPT 換成 STEM OPT 之後，之前失業的那些天要怎麼算啊？
reference_answer: They carry over. With a STEM OPT extension the limit is 150 days of unemployment in aggregate across the whole OPT period, including the post-completion OPT period before the extension, so the extension adds 60 days rather than resetting the count.
source_quote: Students granted a 24-month OPT extension under paragraph (f)(10)(ii)(C)(2) of this section may not accrue an aggregate of more than 150 days of unemployment during a total OPT period, including any post-completion OPT period described in 8 CFR 274a.12(c)(3)(i)(B) and any subsequent 24-month extension period. [...] Students who are granted a 24-month STEM OPT extension are allowed an additional 60 days of unemployment beyond the initial post-completion OPT limit.

question: A STEM OPT extension is a new authorization period, so my unemployment days from regular OPT reset to zero, right?
original: 換成 STEM OPT 就是新的一段了吧？那之前一般 OPT 用掉的失業天數，應該會重新歸零對不對？
reference_answer: They carry over. With a STEM OPT extension the limit is 150 days of unemployment in aggregate across the whole OPT period, including the post-completion OPT period before the extension, so the extension adds 60 days rather than resetting the count.
source_quote: Students granted a 24-month OPT extension under paragraph (f)(10)(ii)(C)(2) of this section may not accrue an aggregate of more than 150 days of unemployment during a total OPT period, including any post-completion OPT period described in 8 CFR 274a.12(c)(3)(i)(B) and any subsequent 24-month extension period. [...] Students who are granted a 24-month STEM OPT extension are allowed an additional 60 days of unemployment beyond the initial post-completion OPT limit.

question: How closely does my job need to relate to my major while I'm on post-completion OPT?
original: 我在用畢業後的 OPT 找工作，工作內容到底要跟我念的科系多相關才行啊？
reference_answer: Your OPT employment must be directly related to your major area of study.
source_quote: An eligible student may request employment authorization for practical training in a position that is directly related to their major area of study. [...] a student may apply to USCIS for authorization for temporary employment for optional practical training directly related to the student's major area of study.

question: Any legal job should count as employment for post-completion OPT, even if it has nothing to do with my major, right?
original: 畢業後用 OPT，只要找到合法的工作就算有就業了吧？就算跟我念的科系沒關係也可以，對嗎？
reference_answer: Your OPT employment must be directly related to your major area of study.
source_quote: An eligible student may request employment authorization for practical training in a position that is directly related to their major area of study. [...] a student may apply to USCIS for authorization for temporary employment for optional practical training directly related to the student's major area of study.

question: Does my employer need to be enrolled in E-Verify for me to get a STEM OPT extension?
original: 我要申請 STEM OPT 延長，公司一定要有加入 E-Verify 嗎？
reference_answer: Your employer must be enrolled in E-Verify and remain a participant in good standing with E-Verify for you to get a STEM OPT extension; a qualifying degree alone is not enough.
source_quote: The student's employer is enrolled in E-Verify, as evidenced by either a valid E-Verify Company Identification number or, if the employer is using an employer agent to create its E-Verify cases, a valid E-Verify Client Company Identification number, and the employer remains a participant in good standing with E-Verify, as determined by USCIS. [...] Remember that your STEM OPT employer must be enrolled in E-Verify.

question: My degree qualifies for STEM OPT, so I can get the extension even if my employer isn't enrolled in E-Verify, right?
original: 我的學位有符合 STEM OPT 資格啊，那公司沒有加入 E-Verify 應該也沒差吧？還是可以申請延長對不對？
reference_answer: Your employer must be enrolled in E-Verify and remain a participant in good standing with E-Verify for you to get a STEM OPT extension; a qualifying degree alone is not enough.
source_quote: The student's employer is enrolled in E-Verify, as evidenced by either a valid E-Verify Company Identification number or, if the employer is using an employer agent to create its E-Verify cases, a valid E-Verify Client Company Identification number, and the employer remains a participant in good standing with E-Verify, as determined by USCIS. [...] Remember that your STEM OPT employer must be enrolled in E-Verify.

question: Once I finish my post-completion OPT and enter the grace period, can I keep working?
original: 我的畢業後 OPT 正常跑完了，接下來是 grace period。那這段時間還可以繼續上班嗎？
reference_answer: No. Post-completion OPT employment authorization ends when the OPT period ends; the 60-day period that follows is for preparing to depart the United States or transferring to another school, not for continued employment.
source_quote: If granted, the employment authorization period for post-completion OPT begins on the requested date of commencement or the date the Form I-765 or successor form is approved, whichever is later, and ends at the conclusion of the remaining time period of post-completion OPT eligibility. [...] An F-1 student who has completed a course of study and any authorized practical training following completion of studies will be allowed an additional 60-day period to prepare for departure from the United States or to transfer in accordance with paragraph (f)(8) of this section.

question: I still have a grace period after my post-completion OPT ends, so I can keep working for my employer during that time, right?
original: 我的畢業後 OPT 結束了，但後面不是還有 grace period 嗎？那這段時間應該還能繼續在原公司上班吧？
reference_answer: No. Post-completion OPT employment authorization ends when the OPT period ends; the 60-day period that follows is for preparing to depart the United States or transferring to another school, not for continued employment.
source_quote: If granted, the employment authorization period for post-completion OPT begins on the requested date of commencement or the date the Form I-765 or successor form is approved, whichever is later, and ends at the conclusion of the remaining time period of post-completion OPT eligibility. [...] An F-1 student who has completed a course of study and any authorized practical training following completion of studies will be allowed an additional 60-day period to prepare for departure from the United States or to transfer in accordance with paragraph (f)(8) of this section.
